Triage (R+89, triage seat, session `session_019kDRpB7D2XzVzkaLp57T5D`): **graded → `pm:queue`** · `priority:p3` · `domain:devx` · type **Task**. `finding` removed.

**Lands in:** `docs/adr/**` — a single docs-only repair PR over the 61 stale full-path mentions (governed surface ⇒ draft PR, human merge; same landing path #13556 used). **Ruled route:** repair, ⛔ no gate. Rationale: enabling `checkBarePaths` on the ADR corpus was measured at 1,056 findings / 616 paths, which is a new noisy gate for a class that a one-off pass closes; a durable record that names a file which no longer exists misdirects the reader, so the 61 are worth one pass, and the per-corpus flag PR #14277 shipped stays off for ADRs by policy until a second census shows the rot re-accumulating. Per mention the dev classifies **moved** (rewrite to the current path) vs **deleted/renamed** (keep the historical path and append a dated "since removed/renamed to …" note — an ADR is a record of its time, so a path that was true when written is not "wrong", only unannotated). ⛔ No decision text is touched; this is citation hygiene, not an ADR amendment.

Size/model suggestion: S–M mechanical (61 sites, classification is the work), `sonnet`/`opus`; PR body must carry the moved/deleted split as a table.
